info.title: SatuSehat Platform API
info.description: SATUSEHAT is Indonesia's national health-data exchange, run by the Ministry of Health (Kementerian Kesehatan). Its platform API has four parts, all on one host and all behind the same OAuth 2.0 client-credentials bearer token: the HL7 FHIR R4 API under `/fhir-r4/v1` (onboarding resources Patient, Practitioner, Organization and Location, plus the clinical integration resources), the token endpoint `/oauth2/v1/accesstoken`, the master-data APIs (KFA drug and device catalogue, Master Sarana Index, master wilayah) and the KYC endpoints. The OpenFn satusehat adaptor exposes only generic get/post/put/patch verbs, so a workflow can call any of these; every documented endpoint is described here.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint.

tags.name: Patient
tags.description: Onboarding FHIR R4 resource: A person receiving care. SatuSehat assigns every patient an IHS number (`P…`) as the resource id.

tags.name: Practitioner
tags.description: Onboarding FHIR R4 resource: A health worker. SatuSehat assigns practitioners an IHS number (`N…`) as the resource id.

tags.name: Organization
tags.description: Onboarding FHIR R4 resource: A healthcare facility or administrative unit (fasyankes).

tags.name: Location
tags.description: Onboarding FHIR R4 resource: A physical place of care within an organization (ward, room, bed, ambulance).

tags.name: AllergyIntolerance
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A record of a patient's allergy or intolerance.

tags.name: Appointment
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A booked or requested appointment.

tags.name: AppointmentResponse
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A participant's reply to an appointment request.

tags.name: CarePlan
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A plan of intended care for a patient.

tags.name: ClinicalImpression
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A clinician's assessment of a patient's condition.

tags.name: Composition
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A structured clinical document (e.g. a discharge summary).

tags.name: Condition
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A diagnosis, problem or clinical concern (coded with ICD-10).

tags.name: DiagnosticReport
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: The findings of a diagnostic test (laboratory, radiology, pathology).

tags.name: Encounter
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: One episode of a patient interacting with a facility (rawat jalan, rawat inap, IGD).

tags.name: EpisodeOfCare
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: An association between a patient and an organization over a period of care.

tags.name: FamilyMemberHistory
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: Health history of a patient's relative.

tags.name: HealthcareService
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A service offered by an organization at a location (poli/unit layanan).

tags.name: ImagingStudy
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A DICOM imaging study and its series/instances.

tags.name: Immunization
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: An administered vaccine dose.

tags.name: Medication
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A medicinal product, coded against the KFA (Kamus Farmalkes) catalogue.

tags.name: MedicationDispense
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: Medication handed over to a patient (pelayanan kefarmasian).

tags.name: MedicationRequest
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A prescription (resep).

tags.name: Observation
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A measurement or simple assertion (vital signs, lab results), coded with LOINC.

tags.name: PractitionerRole
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A practitioner's role at an organization.

tags.name: Procedure
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A procedure performed on a patient (coded with ICD-9-CM).

tags.name: QuestionnaireResponse
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: Answers to a structured questionnaire (screening/assessment forms).

tags.name: RelatedPerson
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A person related to a patient (used for newborns and guardians).

tags.name: ServiceRequest
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A request for a diagnostic or therapeutic service (rujukan, permintaan pemeriksaan).

tags.name: Slot
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A bookable time slot on a schedule.

tags.name: Specimen
tags.description: Integration FHIR R4 resource: A sample taken for analysis.

tags.name: KFA
tags.description: Kamus Farmalkes — the national drug and medical-device catalogue.

tags.name: MasterData
tags.description: Master Sarana Index (facilities) and master wilayah (administrative areas).

tags.name: KYC
tags.description: Patient identity verification (Know Your Customer).

post.summary: Exchange client credentials for a bearer token
post.description: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials handshake. `grant_type=client_credentials` is passed as a query parameter and the client_id/client_secret in a form-encoded body. The returned `access_token` authenticates every other SatuSehat call.

Coding.description: A code drawn from a code system.

CodeableConcept.description: A concept expressed as one or more codings plus free text.

Reference.description: A reference to another FHIR resource.

ContactPoint.description: A phone, email or other contact detail.

Annotation.description: A free-text note with an author and time.

Meta.description: Resource metadata maintained by the server.

OperationOutcomeIssue.description: One problem reported by the server.

OperationOutcome.description: FHIR error payload returned for 4xx/5xx responses.

TokenResponse.description: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials token response. Numeric-looking fields are returned as strings.

access_token.description: Bearer token for the Authorization header.

JsonPatchOperation.description: One RFC 6902 JSON Patch operation, as sent with Content-Type application/json-patch+json.

DomainResource.description: The elements every FHIR R4 resource carries. Concrete resources extend this with allOf.

Patient.description: A person receiving care. SatuSehat assigns every patient an IHS number (`P…`) as the resource id. Documented-subset of the FHIR R4 StructureDefinition; servers may return further R4 elements.

PatientBundle.description: FHIR searchset Bundle carrying Patient resources.

Practitioner.description: A health worker. SatuSehat assigns practitioners an IHS number (`N…`) as the resource id. Documented-subset of the FHIR R4 StructureDefinition; servers may return further R4 elements.

PractitionerBundle.description: FHIR searchset Bundle carrying Practitioner resources.

Organization.description: A healthcare facility or administrative unit (fasyankes). Documented-subset of the FHIR R4 StructureDefinition; servers may return further R4 elements.

OrganizationBundle.description: FHIR searchset Bundle carrying Organization resources.

Location.description: A physical place of care within an organization (ward, room, bed, ambulance). Documented-subset of the FHIR R4 StructureDefinition; servers may return further R4 elements.

LocationBundle.description: FHIR searchset Bundle carrying Location resources.

AllergyIntolerance.description: A record of a patient's allergy or intolerance. Documented-subset of the FHIR R4 StructureDefinition; servers may return further R4 elements.
